counterfactual.change: Reduced initial horizontal velocity from vx=13.718 to vx=5.0 (single field change) – lower displacement per step keeps body inside 20x12 arena for full 140 steps, bounding overshoot <0.15.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has a single free body with high horizontal speed (vx~13.7) and no explicit walls. The engine splits integration into 5 substeps but applies no arena-boundary collision (no walls to collide with), so the body translates beyond x=20−r under gravity alone. By step 139 it is already near the limit (overshoot 0.058) and at step 140 x≈19.329 exceeds the 0.15 in_arena tolerance (overshoot 0.159). Reducing vx removes the escape, confirming speed+missing boundary enforcement is causal.
vision_note: The red circle travels rightward across frames 138-139 until it reaches the right edge of the arena, and in frame 140 it is visibly half outside the boundary at the bottom-right corner. No walls are present to stop or bounce it, so it simply exits the arena instead of colliding.
